name: go-spec-reviewer
description: Use when the user has a Go design doc, spec, RFC, or PRD to review before implementation — "is this spec ready?", "review this before I build it", a planned feature in a Go codebase, or a design that already reads as over-engineered. Not for writing or fixing Go code (use go), CLI flag and config detail (use cobra-viper), or versioning a shipped API (use go-release).
